about: LIN-3150: supervisor failures on record, hand-classed by the author from the 82 candidate tickets that scripts/survey-supervise-failures.mjs finds (a supervisor layer in the title or description, a failure word in the title). Kept: a ticket whose filing describes a supervisor doing the wrong thing, or the machinery around a supervisor failing it. Dropped: plans, features, UI, drift reviews and measurements. type: missed-wake, looping, wrong-routing, lost-input, leaving-altitude. locus: 'model' if the supervisor session's own choice went wrong, 'code' if deterministic plumbing did. action: 'M' if the step that failed is one the census codes mechanical, 'J' if it needed judgement. Read from the ticket title and the first 1,500 characters of its description.
